text:
Evan: dropped two quick variants for billing list: 'inline-overdue' (shows small Pay chip on overdue rows) vs 'header-actions' (global pay/download actions). need quick opinions before tomorrow's review.
Priya: link plz
Evan: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/billing-quick-variants 
Samir: inline-overdue seems better for surfacing urgent invoices. header-actions risk accidental scope confusion (are we paying for org or project?).
Hana: accessibility: overdue chip color in dark theme is 3.8:1. need >=4.5:1. also token shorthand like "8k" is announced weirdly by VoiceOver. aria-label should expose full number.
Evan: good call. we can show shorthand visually and set aria-label="8,000 tokens".
Priya: UX nit: if Pay is inline add a confirmation step. accidental payments are a real product-support headache. micro-modal Confirm/Cancel should do it.
Samir: can we add a tiny sparkline in dense rows so users keep trend context without expanding? lightweight and non-interactive with aria-label="usage trend last 30 days".
ux-bot: Evan uploaded updated mocks (inline-overdue-v2, header-actions-v1)
Evan: patched: increased overdue contrast, added aria-labels for token amounts, included optional sparkline, and prototyped Pay confirmation modal. trimmed expand animation to 120ms on mobile.
Hana: LGTM after contrast tweak. one more: make chevron focusable and ensure Enter toggles expansion (keyboard users).
Priya: metrics plan: short pilot 2 weeks, 25% users inline-overdue+sparkline, 25% header-actions, rest control. track: pay-clicks, download-clicks, invoice-related support tickets, avg rows expanded.
Evan: adding the pilot to tomorrow's agenda (5m). if anyone spots blockers for a11y or payments flow ping me. :thumbsup:
